//: Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to `web`.
VITE_API_BASE must be set in the Vercel dashboard to the deployed API
origin (e.g. https://sqlproj-api.onrender.com). Vite inlines VITE_* at
BUILD time, not at runtime, so changing it requires a redeploy - setting
it after the fact and expecting the live site to pick it up will not work.
No SPA catch-all rewrite here on purpose: the app has no client-side
router (App.tsx switches tabs with useState), so every real page is `/`.
A catch-all would turn genuine 404s into a silently blank index.html.
